capabilities: Generate a branching note tree from a root concept using LLM prompts
Expand branches incrementally or in batch with node budgets
Find and link related vault notes via lexical and semantic matching
Write structured deep-dive sections and generate spaced-repetition review cards
Answer grounded questions about a node in a chat with adoptable suggested children
extras: The Batch Generation Prompt is implemented but no UI action sends it; batch expansion uses repeated Expansion prompts instead. The Screenshots section is empty and installation is by manually copying plugin files.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to expand a single concept into a large, structured hierarchy of interconnected notes, and connecting new concepts to existing vault notes has to be done by hand.

relations.evidence: Any OpenAI-compatible API | DeepSeek (default), OpenAI, OpenRouter, Ollama, LM Studio…

summary: AI plugin that grows a typed concept into a deep, branching tree of linked Markdown notes, with connection discovery, deep dives, and spaced-repetition review.
